## Specification

### Component: Skeleton

A placeholder that reserves space while content loads. Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
- `<div class="ui-skeleton [ui-skeleton-circle|ui-skeleton-block]" aria-hidden="true" data-shape style="width;height">`.

#### Props
- `shape` `line` (default, 16px tall) | `circle` (width = height, 40px default) | `block` (96px tall). `width`, `height`: number = px or a CSS string.

#### Visual rules
- Base fill `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 8%, transparent)` (10% in dark). Highlight band: gradient `transparent 30%, shine 50%, transparent 70%`, size 200% × 100%, shine = surface 70% in light, foreground 9% in dark.
- Animation `var(--animate-shimmer)` (1.6s linear infinite). Radius: line `--radius-sm`, block `--radius-md`, circle full.

#### Accessibility
- Aria-hidden. The loading region sets `aria-busy="true"` and holds a visually hidden `role="status"` message.

#### Motion
- Reduced motion: `animation: none; background-image: none` (static fill).

#### Acceptance checks
- Shapes measure as specified; the shimmer runs unless reduced motion is set; visible in dark mode.

export * from './skeleton';

### `ui/components/skeleton/skeleton.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type SkeletonShape = 'line' | 'circle' | 'block';

export interface SkeletonProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** `line` (a text line, default), `circle` (avatar) or `block` (image, card). */
  shape?: SkeletonShape;
  /** Width: a number is px, a string any CSS length (`"60%"`). Lines and blocks fill the width by default. */
  width?: number | string;
  /** Height: a number is px. Lines default to 16px, blocks to 96px; a circle is as tall as it is wide. */
  height?: number | string;
}

/**
 * Skeleton — a placeholder that reserves space while content loads.
 * Decorative (`aria-hidden`): mark the loading region with `aria-busy="true"`
 * and give assistive tech a status message. Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Skeleton = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SkeletonProps>(function Skeleton(
  { shape = 'line', width, height, className, style, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const size: CSSProperties = {};
  if (width !== undefined) size.width = width;
  if (height !== undefined) size.height = height;
  if (shape === 'circle') {
    size.width ??= 40;
    size.height ??= size.width;
  }
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      aria-hidden="true"
      data-shape={shape}
      className={cn('ui-skeleton', shape !== 'line' && `ui-skeleton-${shape}`, className)}
      style={{ ...size, ...style }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/skeleton.css`

```css
/* Skeleton ----------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-skeleton" aria-hidden="true" style="width:60%">   text line (16px)
   + shape: -circle (width = height, set inline) | -block (96px, md radius)
   A faint band sweeps across (--animate-shimmer); reduced motion = static.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-skeleton {
    --ui-skeleton-base: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 8%, transparent);
    --ui-skeleton-shine: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface) 70%, transparent);
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background-color: var(--ui-skeleton-base);
    background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 30%, var(--ui-skeleton-shine) 50%, transparent 70%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    animation: var(--animate-shimmer);
  }
  /* On dark surfaces the highlight is a lighter band, not a darker one */
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-skeleton {
    --ui-skeleton-base: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 10%, transparent);
    --ui-skeleton-shine: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 9%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-skeleton-circle { border-radius: 9999px; }
  .ui-skeleton-block { height: 6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-skeleton { animation: none; background-image: none; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Skeleton shapes** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/skeleton/shapes.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@/ui/components/skeleton';

export default function SkeletonShapes() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6" aria-busy="true">
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">
        Loading
      </span>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Skeleton width="85%" />
        <Skeleton width="60%" />
        <Skeleton width="72%" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Skeleton shape="circle" width={48} />
        <Skeleton shape="circle" width={32} />
        <Skeleton shape="circle" width={24} />
      </div>
      <Skeleton shape="block" height={96} />
    </div>
  );
}
```
